purpose: Fresh terse player-language Gate 3 tranche F benchmark authored after r16 deployment and not used to construct r16.
blindnessPolicy: This tranche was authored after r16 was merged and deployed and was not used to construct r16.
Do not edit or retroactively regrade this tranche after its first paid live run.
Do not exactly reuse prior Gate 2 or Gate 3 A/B/C/D/E player-language questions.

cases.question: opening discard before first player roll right?

semanticCriteria.statement: The mandatory opening discard and Territory arrangement occur before the first-player roll.

cases.question: used my action already. banked asset trigger still works?
expectedSourcePatterns: Discarding an Asset as an Action

semanticCriteria.statement: A normal banked Asset trigger does not spend an Action unless its text or another rule says it does.

cases.question: tiebreak tied again. bonuses on the reroll?

semanticCriteria.statement: Further Tiebreak Roll rerolls still exclude battle bonuses, modifiers, advantage/disadvantage, card effects, and prior totals.

cases.question: won my first military fight on their turn. command?

semanticCriteria.statement: Military gains 1 Command from its first battle victory each turn even when that win happens on the opponent's turn.

cases.question: they refused terms then we withdrew. stake comes back?

semanticCriteria.statement: A no-winner withdrawal after refused Terms returns the Stake and does not impose or ratify the Proposal.

cases.question: already ratified proposal. can i offer it again?

semanticCriteria.statement: An already-ratified Proposal may be offered again for its tactical effects, but it cannot be ratified again or give the normal new-ratification reward.

cases.question: qualified for financial capacity then treasury dropped. still have it?

semanticCriteria.statement: Financial Capacity eligibility is fixed at its after-Capture check; later Treasury changes do not remove it for that turn.

cases.question: i captured the territory. do i get its deed too?

semanticCriteria.statement: Territory control does not transfer Deed ownership.

cases.question: mission condition hit. does it auto finish?

semanticCriteria.statement: Satisfying the Mission requirement does not complete it automatically; completion requires the later Denouement Action.

cases.question: their tactic is face up. interference without surveillance?

semanticCriteria.statement: A face-up opposing choice can be directly Interfered with for 2 Intel at the proper response timing without using Surveillance.

cases.question: rite of blood plus transmutation still counts?

semanticCriteria.statement: Using Transmutation does not by itself prevent Rite of Blood from completing if the battle is otherwise eligible.

cases.question: ritual battle ended by withdrawal. interrupted?

semanticCriteria.statement: Withdrawal neither completes nor interrupts the Ritual because there is no winner or loser.

cases.question: three enemy cards hit graveyard same aftermath. three conviction?

semanticCriteria.statement: Multiple qualifying cards in the same battle Aftermath produce only 1 normal Conviction gain.
Condemnation redirects opposing Tactics, not cards left in Reserve; Reserve cards are discarded normally.
Rally is only legal while attacking in a battle the General initiated.

cases.question: fieldcraft turns off defensive edge too?

semanticCriteria.statement: Fieldcraft does not alter Defensive Edge.

cases.question: final judgment purge can cost zero?

semanticCriteria.statement: Final Judgment reduces the Purge cost to a minimum of 1, never 0.

cases.question: witch hunter attacked and won. pursuit fires?

semanticCriteria.statement: Relentless Pursuit requires defeating an attacking opponent, so it does not fire when Witch Hunter was the attacker.
